historical_commentary.text: This note updates an earlier 2002 Tech Note's 4D View spreadsheet-style component to add one-click printing of 4D View areas exactly as displayed, using PV PRINT and related commands, and documents a syntax change (PV SORT COLUMN replacing part of PV SET COLUMN HEADER) between 4D View versions. 4D View was a companion spreadsheet/grid plug-in for 4D that predates 4D View Pro (introduced in 4D v17, 2018), and its entire PV_* command set has since been superseded by 4D View Pro's modern spreadsheet engine and API; the note's specific commands and workflow are obsolete, though the general goal (letting users print exactly what they see in a data grid) remains a standard requirement addressed differently in current tooling.
related_updates: The legacy 4D View plug-in and its PV_* command set have been superseded by 4D View Pro, introduced in 4D v17 (2018), which uses a different, modern spreadsheet API
Current 4D View Pro areas have their own built-in printing and export capabilities rather than relying on PV PRINT/PV EXECUTE COMMAND
